subtitle: Master the natural, organic sound of acoustic guitars

introduction.title: Acoustic Guitars: Pure, Natural Sound
introduction.text: Discover the timeless appeal of acoustic guitars - from intimate fingerpicking to powerful strumming, these instruments need no amplification to move hearts.

columns.title: What Makes Acoustics Special
columns.text: Natural resonance and projection. Intimate, organic sound character. Perfect for songwriting and campfires. No electricity required - pure portability. Rich harmonic complexity from wood resonance.

cards.title: Steel-String Acoustics
items: Bright, crisp tone: Steel strings provide clarity and punch
Strong projection: Cuts through mix in band settings
Versatile dynamics: From gentle fingerpicking to aggressive strumming
Genre flexibility: Folk, country, rock, pop, blues

cards.title: Playing Styles
items: Strumming: Rhythm guitar for songs and accompaniment
Fingerpicking: Intricate melodies and complex arrangements
Flatpicking: Leads and fast bluegrass-style picking
Percussive: Body tapping and rhythm techniques

cards.title: Body Shapes
items: Dreadnought: Largest body, powerful bass response, versatile
Concert/Auditorium: Balanced tone, comfortable for smaller players
Grand Auditorium: Great for fingerpicking, balanced across frequencies
Parlor: Vintage feel, focused midrange, great for recording
Jumbo: Maximum volume and projection, bold sound

cards.title: Wood Types
items: Spruce Top: Bright, clear tone with good projection
Cedar Top: Warm, woody tone with quick response
Mahogany Top: Focused midrange, vintage character
Rosewood Back/Sides: Rich overtones, powerful bass
Maple Back/Sides: Bright, punchy tone with clarity

fields.label: Pros
fields.value: Lower cost, pure natural sound, no electronics to fail, lighter weight

fields.label: Best for
fields.value: Home playing, small venues, recording with mics

fields.label: Pros
fields.value: Can be amplified, great for live performance, built-in tuners often included, EQ controls

fields.label: Best for
fields.value: Live performance, recording direct, band settings

cards.title: Intermediate ($400-1200)
tableRows: Electronics, easy action, great for recording

cards.title: Daily Care
items: Wipe down strings after playing
Store in a case or on a stand
Keep away from extreme temperatures
Maintain 45-55% humidity
Loosen strings for long storage

cards.title: Periodic Maintenance
items: Change strings every 3-6 months
Professional setup annually
Check neck relief and intonation
Clean and condition fretboard
Polish body (avoid getting on strings)

fields.label: Sound Quality
fields.value: Clear, balanced tone across all strings; good sustain and projection; no buzzing or dead spots; harmonics ring clearly

fields.label: Playability
fields.value: Comfortable neck shape and width; appropriate string action height; easy fretting without excessive pressure; good intonation up the neck

cards.title: Red Flags to Avoid
items: High action that makes playing difficult
Visible cracks in the top or back
Buzzing that can't be fixed with setup
Warped or twisted neck
Loose or lifting bridge
Dead spots or notes that don't ring out
